name: list-filters
description: A list's where: equality on the instance type's own fields, by key, and on a field a behavior lets a list filter on, or a member of one, by its qualified name (Workflow.status), a list of values, null for no value, paging with the cursor in creation order, a page read through an index, a page that scans a bounded number of instances when none serves it, and what where refuses.
